# Shader tools

6 tools. Registered under `GODOT_MCP_PROFILE=core`.

[← All categories](README.md)

## `create_shader`

Create a new Godot shader file (.gdshader) with optional skeleton code. Optionally creates a companion ShaderMaterial .tres file. Returns an error if the file already exists unless overwrite is true.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `shader_path` | `string` | yes | Path where the .gdshader file will be saved, e.g. 'res://shaders/my_shader.gdshader' |
| `shader_type` | `string` | — | Shader type. 'spatial' (default) for 3D surfaces, 'canvas_item' for 2D/UI, 'particles' for GPU particles, 'sky' for sky shaders, 'fog' for volumetric fog. One of: `"spatial"`, `"canvas_item"`, `"particles"`, `"sky"`, `"fog"`. |
| `code` | `string` | — | Optional full shader source code. If omitted, a minimal skeleton is generated. If provided without a 'shader_type' directive, one is prepended automatically. |
| `overwrite` | `boolean` | — | Set to true to replace an existing shader file. Defaults to false to prevent accidental overwrites. |
| `material_path` | `string` | — | Optional path to also save a companion ShaderMaterial .tres file, e.g. 'res://materials/my_material.tres' |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/17-shader.json`, test SH-01:

```json
{
  "shader_path": "res://test_shader.gdshader",
  "shader_type": "spatial"
}
```

## `edit_shader`

Replace or append to the source code of an existing .gdshader file. Changes take effect immediately — any node using a ShaderMaterial referencing this shader will recompile.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `shader_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the existing .gdshader file to edit |
| `code` | `string` | yes | New shader source code. Replaces the entire file contents by default. Set append: true to add to the end instead. |
| `append` | `boolean` | — | If true, the provided code is appended to the existing file instead of replacing it. Defaults to false. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/17-shader.json`, test SH-04:

```json
{
  "shader_path": "res://test_shader.gdshader",
  "code": "shader_type spatial;\n\nuniform vec4 albedo : source_color = vec4(1.0);\n\nvoid fragment() {\n\tALBEDO = albedo.rgb;\n}\n"
}
```

## `assign_material`

Assign a ShaderMaterial to a node in the current scene. Provide either shader_path (creates a new in-memory ShaderMaterial, optionally saved with save_material_path) or material_path (loads an existing .tres ShaderMaterial). Works on GeometryInstance3D nodes (use surface_index) and CanvasItem nodes. Supports Ctrl+Z undo.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Scene-relative path to the node (must be GeometryInstance3D such as MeshInstance3D, or a CanvasItem such as Sprite2D) |
| `shader_path` | `string` | — | Path to a .gdshader file to create a new in-memory ShaderMaterial from |
| `material_path` | `string` | — | Path to an existing ShaderMaterial .tres file to load and assign |
| `surface_index` | `integer` | — | Surface slot index for GeometryInstance3D nodes (e.g. MeshInstance3D). Defaults to 0. |
| `save_material_path` | `string` | — | When using shader_path, also save the newly created ShaderMaterial to this .tres path so it persists across sessions |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/17-shader.json`, test SH-06:

```json
{
  "node_path": "TestBox",
  "shader_path": "res://test_shader.gdshader"
}
```

## `set_shader_param`

Set the value of a uniform parameter on a node's ShaderMaterial. Supports Ctrl+Z undo. Value types: number (float/int), boolean, [x,y] array (vec2), [x,y,z] array (vec3), [r,g,b,a] array (Color), '#rrggbb' hex string (Color), or 'res://...' path (sampler2D Texture).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Scene-relative path to the node whose ShaderMaterial will be updated |
| `param_name` | `string` | yes | Name of the uniform variable in the shader, e.g. 'albedo_color', 'roughness', 'tiling' |
| `param_value` | any | yes | Value to set. Use a number for float/int, [x,y] for vec2, [x,y,z] for vec3, [r,g,b,a] for Color (0–1 range), '#rrggbb' string for Color hex, or 'res://...' path string for Texture (sampler2D) uniforms. |
| `surface_index` | `integer` | — | Surface slot index for GeometryInstance3D nodes. Defaults to 0. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/17-shader.json`, test SH-07:

```json
{
  "node_path": "TestBox",
  "param_name": "albedo",
  "param_value": "Color(0, 1, 0, 1)"
}
```

## `get_shader_info`

Return the source code, shader type, and uniform list for a shader. Can inspect via a .gdshader file path, a ShaderMaterial .tres file path, or a node path. When called with a node_path or material_path, also returns the current value of each uniform parameter.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `shader_path` | `string` | — | Path to a .gdshader file |
| `material_path` | `string` | — | Path to a ShaderMaterial .tres file |
| `node_path` | `string` | — | Scene-relative path to a node with a ShaderMaterial assigned |
| `surface_index` | `integer` | — | Surface slot for GeometryInstance3D nodes when using node_path. Defaults to 0. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/17-shader.json`, test SH-02:

```json
{
  "shader_path": "res://test_shader.gdshader"
}
```

## `validate_shader`

Validate a Godot shader for structural correctness: checks for a valid 'shader_type' declaration and whether Godot recognizes the declared mode. Note: full GLSL syntax errors inside function bodies are not detectable via GDScript — check Godot's Output panel for GPU compile errors after assigning the shader to a material.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `shader_path` | `string` | — | Path to an existing .gdshader file to validate |
| `code` | `string` | — | Inline shader source code to validate (alternative to shader_path; useful for checking code before saving) |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/17-shader.json`, test SH-03:

```json
{
  "shader_path": "res://test_shader.gdshader"
}
```
